title: Cornelius and Peter's Vision, The First Gentile Converts

questions.question: Who was Cornelius?
options: A centurion of the Italian Cohort, a devout man who feared God and gave generously to the people
A Roman governor of Caesarea who sought spiritual wisdom
A Gentile convert who had been circumcised and kept the Law
A soldier in Herod's court who had heard of Jesus's miracles
questions.correctAnswer: A centurion of the Italian Cohort, a devout man who feared God and gave generously to the people
questions.explanation: Acts 10:1-2 (ESV): "At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion of what was known as the Italian Cohort, a devout man who feared God with all his household, gave alms generously to the people, and prayed continually to God."

questions.question: In a vision at the ninth hour, an angel told Cornelius his prayers and alms had done what before God?
options: Ascended as a memorial before God
Been heard and accepted with pleasure
Pleased God and warranted a great reward
Been written in the heavenly book of remembrance
questions.correctAnswer: Ascended as a memorial before God
questions.explanation: Acts 10:4 (ESV): "Your prayers and your alms have ascended as a memorial before God."

questions.question: The angel told Cornelius to send men to Joppa and call for someone there. Who was he to call for?
options: Simon who is called Peter, staying with Simon the tanner
John the apostle, staying with Mary the mother of Mark
Philip the evangelist, staying in Caesarea
Barnabas the Levite, staying in the upper city
questions.correctAnswer: Simon who is called Peter, staying with Simon the tanner
questions.explanation: Acts 10:5-6 (ESV): "And now send men to Joppa and bring one Simon who is called Peter. He is lodging with one Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the sea."

questions.question: While waiting for Cornelius' men, Peter prayed on the rooftop and fell into a trance. What did he see?
options: Something like a great sheet descending, held at its four corners, containing all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds
A blazing fire consuming unclean offerings on an altar
A vision of many nations streaming toward Jerusalem
A scroll written on front and back with God's commands
questions.correctAnswer: Something like a great sheet descending, held at its four corners, containing all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds
questions.explanation: Acts 10:11-12 (ESV): "and saw the heavens opened and something like a great sheet descending, being let down by its four corners upon the earth. In it were all kinds of animals and reptiles and birds of the air."

questions.question: A voice said "Rise, Peter; kill and eat." Why did Peter refuse?
options: "By no means, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean."
"Lord, the Law of Moses forbids this and I cannot break it."
"These animals are offered to idols and I cannot eat them."
"I am fasting today and cannot eat until evening prayer."
questions.correctAnswer: "By no means, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean."
questions.explanation: Acts 10:14 (ESV): "But Peter said, 'By no means, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.'"

questions.question: The voice replied to Peter's refusal: "What God has cleansed, do not call..."?
options: common
unclean
impure
defiled
questions.explanation: Acts 10:15 (ESV): "And the voice came to him again a second time, 'What God has cleansed, do not call common.'"

questions.question: How many times did the vision occur before the sheet was taken back up into heaven?
options: Three times
Two times
Once only
Four times
questions.explanation: Acts 10:16 (ESV): "This happened three times, and the thing was taken up at once to heaven."

questions.question: Peter went with Cornelius' men without objection, because the Spirit told him to go. What did Peter say when he arrived at Cornelius' house about Jewish law?
options: "You yourselves know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with or to visit anyone of another nation, but God has shown me that I should not call any person common or unclean."
"Jewish law separates us, but the Spirit of God unites us in Christ."
"The Law has been fulfilled in Christ and barriers are now gone."
"I come as one sent by God, and his authority exceeds all laws."
questions.correctAnswer: "You yourselves know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with or to visit anyone of another nation, but God has shown me that I should not call any person common or unclean."
questions.explanation: Acts 10:28 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'You yourselves know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with or to visit anyone of another nation, but God has shown me that I should not call any person common or unclean.'"

questions.question: Peter declared his understanding: "Truly I understand that God shows no partiality, but in every nation anyone who fears him and does what is right is..."?
options: "acceptable to him."
"saved by him."
"heard by him."
"loved by him."
questions.explanation: Acts 10:34-35 (ESV): "Truly I understand that God shows no partiality, but in every nation anyone who fears him and does what is right is acceptable to him."

questions.question: Peter preached that Jesus is "Lord of all" and that God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power. Jesus "went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for..."?
options: "God was with him."
"the Spirit empowered him."
"God sent him for this."
"he is the Son of God."
questions.explanation: Acts 10:38 (ESV): "how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power. He went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him."

questions.question: Peter declared that God raised Jesus and made Him manifest not to all people but to whom specifically?
options: Witnesses chosen beforehand by God, who ate and drank with him after his resurrection
The eleven apostles who were with Him throughout His ministry
Those who had believed at Pentecost and thereafter
All who lived in Jerusalem and throughout Judea
questions.correctAnswer: Witnesses chosen beforehand by God, who ate and drank with him after his resurrection
questions.explanation: Acts 10:40-41 (ESV): "God raised him on the third day and made him to appear, not to all the people but to us who had been chosen by God as witnesses, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead."

questions.question: While Peter was still speaking, what fell on all who heard the word?
options: The Holy Spirit
The power of God
A great joy
A holy fear
questions.explanation: Acts 10:44 (ESV): "While Peter was still saying these things, the Holy Spirit fell on all who heard the word."

questions.question: The Jewish believers who came with Peter were amazed because the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out even on the Gentiles. How did they know this?
options: They heard them speaking in tongues and extolling God
They saw fire rest upon them as at Pentecost
They felt the building shake as when they first received the Spirit
An angel appeared and confirmed God's acceptance of them
questions.correctAnswer: They heard them speaking in tongues and extolling God
questions.explanation: Acts 10:46 (ESV): "For they were hearing them speaking in tongues and extolling God."

questions.question: Peter commanded that the Gentile believers be baptized. In whose name?
options: In the name of Jesus Christ
In the name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit
In the name of the Lord God of Israel
In the name of the Lord Jesus and the Holy Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: In the name of Jesus Christ
questions.explanation: Acts 10:48 (ESV): "And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ."

questions.question: Peter declared that all the prophets bear witness about Jesus — that everyone who believes in him receives what through his name?
options: Forgiveness of sins
Eternal life
The gift of the Spirit
The righteousness of God
questions.explanation: Acts 10:43 (ESV): "To him all the prophets bear witness that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name."

key_verse_text: "Truly I understand that God shows no partiality, but in every nation anyone who fears him and does what is right is acceptable to him."
